events.description: A large cloud of dust or smoke erupts suddenly from the right side of the road near a parked white car, indicating a high-speed impact or explosion off-camera; the white car remains stationary but is adjacent to the event.
A person is violently ejected from a vehicle and tumbles through the air in front of the dashcam car, indicating a severe crash just ahead or to the side; debris and mist fill the windshield.
The ejected person lands on the roadside verge; the dashcam vehicle continues forward past the incident site, with visible debris still airborne and on the road.

Severe multi-vehicle collision on a highway, involving at least one large truck and multiple smaller vehicles; wreckage is scattered across the road with dust/smoke still rising, indicating the crash occurred just before or at the start of the clip.
A dark SUV collides with the rear of a white truck on a two-lane road, causing immediate visible impact and debris.
A large fireball erupts from the point of impact between the SUV and truck, indicating a rapid combustion event (likely fuel or cargo ignition) following the collision.
A large, sudden fireball erupts on the road ahead, with rapid expansion of flames and dark smoke—characteristic of a violent explosion, likely from a vehicle or fuel source.

A vehicle (likely the one that exploded) is involved in a catastrophic crash, evidenced by the immediate post-impact fireball and subsequent wreckage visible on the left side of the road starting at f1.
A severe vehicle collision is visible ahead on the road, with a large plume of smoke/dust and debris in the air; a person stands near a damaged vehicle on the left shoulder.
A blue van collides with a motorcycle on a wet road; the motorcycle is struck and thrown sideways as the van passes.
A black sedan collides with a green truck on the left side of the road, causing a large dust/debris cloud and visible vehicle displacement.
